decisions.note: Skill ID 202082 is verified as JP ワンチャンス. The Chinese idiom is not the JP title, and choosing between a preserved loan-title such as 'One Chance' and a Vietnamese semantic title needs a project convention.
Pinned skill ID 409011 is JP モンスターマシン. Normalize the Chinese semantic rendering to the stable English loan-title Monster Machine.
Skill ID 200632 is verified as JP 仕掛け抜群. The Chinese wording is not a reliable literal bridge here, and the compact Japanese racing phrase has multiple plausible Vietnamese renderings.
Skill ID 200721 is JP キラーチューン. A Latin rendering is likely appropriate, but 'Killer Tune' versus other established title forms should be harmonized before locking.
Skill ID 201152 verifies JP 束縛; the Vietnamese title 'Trói buộc' is a direct, unambiguous rendering.

Skill ID 100703111 is verified as JP 押し寄せるジュテーム, which mixes Japanese with the French loan 'je t’aime'. A Vietnamese title should preserve that stylization rather than follow the flattened Chinese semantic rendering.
Skill ID 105502211 is JP いざ、ショーベラスタイム♪. The source partially romanizes a stylized title, but the intended stable Latin rendering of ショーベラス is not established by repository evidence.
Skill ID 201652 is verified as JP いいとこ入った！. This is an idiomatic exclamation whose natural Vietnamese title depends on context and tone; the Chinese phrase is not sufficient authority.
Skill ID 101902121 is verified as JP たぎってきたぁ～～っ！！. The elongated, excited delivery is title-significant and has several natural Vietnamese renderings, so defer rather than flatten it.
Skill ID 110201 uses the stylized Latin title Do Ya Breakin! in JP game references; restore that title instead of retaining the Chinese semantic substitution.
Skill ID 203461 verifies JP 傑出; 'Kiệt xuất' is the direct Vietnamese equivalent and preserves the compact title.
Skill ID 103602211 is verified as the much shorter JP title 刑苦. The Chinese source expands the wording, and a natural Vietnamese canonical title cannot be safely inferred from that expansion.

The stylized food-themed source title at skill ID 414011 lacks a reliably verified JP alias in the available evidence; literal translation would risk preserving a Chinese localization joke rather than the JP title.
Skill ID 101901111 is verified as JP 限界ウママニア. The ウママニア wordplay/loan construction has several possible Vietnamese treatments and no repository convention currently fixes one.
Skill ID 202822 verifies JP 迷いなし. 'Không do dự' follows the Japanese title directly rather than the looser Chinese adjective.
Skill ID 200133 verifies JP 根幹距離×, referring to standard distances that are multiples of 400 m. Use 'Cự ly chuẩn' and preserve the × tier marker.
Skill ID 200132 verifies JP 根幹距離○, referring to standard distances that are multiples of 400 m. Use the same 'Cự ly chuẩn' base and preserve ○.
Skill ID 200131 verifies JP 根幹距離◎, referring to standard distances that are multiples of 400 m. Use the same 'Cự ly chuẩn' base and preserve ◎.
Skill ID 102402211 verifies JP バレルロール. Preserve the established aviation loan-title as Barrel Roll rather than the Chinese semantic calque.
Skill ID 111191 is verified as JP 夢寐に見る銀世界. The poetic compound has several plausible Vietnamese titles, so defer until wording is harmonized rather than locking a literal Chinese-derived phrase.
